responses.text: Heck Gunderson, you are under arrest for the murder of Ted Gunderson.
It is my duty to inform you that murder is a serious crime.
As a murderer you should be feeling emotions such as guilt, sorrow, and shame.
If not, you may wish to consult a mental health professional.
I hope this experience has taught you an important lesson about the value of human life.
Dead or alive, you're coming with me.
Please allow me to escort you to the nearest criminal processing facility.
Stand back, citizens. Deceased bodies are a known source of illness, and a potential tripping hazard.
